note: Draft exercises written for Project All Star. All text is original. Every entry needs trainer review before it is shown as advice to members.

exercises.name: Ready stance and breathing
instructions: Stand with feet about shoulder width apart, knees soft and hands loosely closed in front of the belt.
Keep the back tall and the eyes forward.
Breathe in through the nose for a count of three and out through the mouth for a count of four.
Hold for one minute, relaxing the shoulders on each out-breath.

exercises.name: Front stance walking
instructions: Step forward into a long, low stance with the front knee bent over the toes and the back leg straight.
Keep both feet flat and the hips facing forward.
Slide the back foot up and step into the next stance without bobbing up and down.
Cross the training hall slowly, then return.

exercises.name: Straight punch drill
instructions: Start in a front stance with one fist at the hip, palm up.
Extend the other arm straight ahead while turning the fist palm down, stopping before the elbow locks hard.
Pull the fist back to the hip as the other arm goes out.
Do sets of ten on each side, focusing on a relaxed shoulder.

exercises.name: Basic block set (low, middle, high)
instructions: From a steady stance, sweep one forearm down across the body to guard the lower area.
Return to the starting position, then raise the forearm to guard the middle, then the face level.
Move slowly at first, naming each level out loud.
Repeat on the other side.

exercises.name: Front kick, slow control
instructions: Stand tall and lift the knee in front of the body.
Snap the lower leg out, striking with the ball of the foot, then fold it back at once.
Place the foot down under control, without leaning back.
Do five slow kicks per leg, holding a wall or partner's shoulder for balance if needed.

exercises.name: Hip opening warm-up
instructions: Stand holding a wall and swing one leg forward and back ten times.
Swing the same leg side to side ten times.
Draw ten slow circles with the knee in each direction.
Switch legs.

exercises.name: Form (kata) slow walk-through
instructions: Pick the form your coach has assigned for your current belt.
Perform it at half speed, pausing briefly at the end of every move to check stance and hand position.
Repeat at full speed once, then once more with eyes on a fixed point ahead.
Note any move that felt unsteady and tell your coach.

exercises.name: Partner distance drill
instructions: Face a partner at arm's length plus one step.
One partner steps in and out while the other mirrors the movement to keep the same gap.
Switch the lead after thirty seconds.
Keep the movements light and never make contact.

exercises.name: Plank hold for stance strength
instructions: Rest on the forearms and toes with the body in a straight line.
Keep the neck long and the hips level.
Hold for twenty seconds, rest, and repeat three times.
Build up by five seconds each week as comfortable.

exercises.name: Horse stance hold
instructions: Stand with feet wide, toes slightly out, and sink until the thighs are as low as feels comfortable.
Keep the knees tracking over the toes and the chest upright.
Hold for fifteen seconds, then stand and shake out the legs.
Repeat three times.

exercises.name: Cool-down stretch sequence
instructions: Sit with legs straight and reach toward the toes for twenty seconds.
Move to a seated butterfly position and lean forward gently for twenty seconds.
Stand and pull each heel toward the hip for twenty seconds per side.
Finish with ten slow breaths.

exercises.name: Skipping for footwork
instructions: Hold the rope handles at hip height with elbows close to the body.
Jump low, landing softly on the balls of the feet.
Skip for thirty seconds, rest for thirty, and repeat five times.
Stop if the lower legs hurt.

exercises.name: Mountain pose
instructions: Stand with feet hip width apart and weight spread evenly across both feet.
Lengthen the spine and let the arms hang by the sides with palms forward.
Breathe slowly for five to ten breaths.

exercises.name: Cat and cow flow
instructions: Come onto hands and knees with wrists under shoulders and knees under hips.
Breathe in and let the belly drop while lifting the chest and tailbone.
Breathe out and round the back toward the ceiling.
Move with the breath for eight to ten rounds.

exercises.name: Downward-facing dog
instructions: From hands and knees, tuck the toes and lift the hips up and back.
Press the floor away and keep the knees slightly bent if the hamstrings feel tight.
Hold for five slow breaths, then lower the knees to rest.

exercises.name: Warrior two
instructions: Step the feet wide apart and turn the front foot out.
Bend the front knee over the ankle and stretch the arms out to the sides at shoulder height.
Look over the front hand and hold for five breaths.
Switch sides.

exercises.name: Tree pose for balance
instructions: Stand on one leg and rest the other foot on the calf or inner thigh, never on the knee.
Bring the palms together at the chest and fix the eyes on a still point.
Hold for five breaths and switch sides.

exercises.name: Child's pose rest
instructions: Kneel and sit back toward the heels, folding forward with the arms stretched ahead.
Rest the forehead on the mat and let the shoulders soften.
Stay for ten slow breaths.

exercises.name: Bridge pose
instructions: Lie on the back with knees bent and feet flat, hip width apart.
Press into the feet and lift the hips until the body forms a gentle slope.
Hold for five breaths and lower slowly. Repeat three times.

exercises.name: Lying relaxation and slow breathing
instructions: Lie on the back with arms slightly away from the body and palms up.
Breathe in for a count of four and out for a count of six.
Let each part of the body feel heavy, from feet to head, for about five minutes.

exercises.name: Marching warm-up with arm swings
instructions: March in place to a steady beat, lifting the knees to a comfortable height.
Add easy arm swings that follow the rhythm.
Keep going for three minutes, gradually picking up the pace.

exercises.name: Grapevine step
instructions: Step to the right, cross the left foot behind, step right again and tap the left foot beside it.
Repeat to the left.
Do eight counts each way, then add a clap on the tap.

exercises.name: Side step with reach
instructions: Step wide to the side while the opposite arm reaches overhead.
Bring the feet together and lower the arm.
Alternate sides to the beat for two minutes.

exercises.name: Low-impact bounce and twist
instructions: Bounce gently on bent knees with one foot always touching the floor.
Add a small twist of the torso to each side, arms relaxed.
Continue for two minutes, then rest for thirty seconds.

exercises.name: Hip sway combination
instructions: Take four slow side steps with a smooth sway of the hips.
Follow with four quick steps in place.
Repeat the pattern four times, keeping the knees soft.

exercises.name: Cool-down stretch and slow sway
instructions: Sway slowly from side to side while the breathing settles.
Stretch the calves against a wall for twenty seconds per leg.
Reach both arms overhead and lean gently to each side for ten seconds.
